routePlan.summary: Monster -> Unknown -> Monster -> Shop -> Unknown -> RestSite -> Monster -> Elite -> Treasure -> Monster -> RestSite -> Monster -> Monster -> Monster -> RestSite -> Boss

runPlan.archetype: Strength plus AoE to race Kin priest; early attacks, upgrades, strike removal.
runPlan.bossPrep: Have ~30/turn into the priest, 3-4 block cards, ≥80% HP entry; smith Inflame/attacks; Flex potion for a burst turn; AoE only incidental.
runPlan.summary: Take attacks first 3 fights (Inflame/Demon Form/Whirlwind), remove Strikes/Defends, smith attacks. Elites only at ≥78% HP after a campfire. Boss: race priest, ~30+/turn; keep potions for burst.
